chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Two categories of persons will face ruin on account of me: he who loves me with exaggeration, and he who hates me intensely.

key_terms.مُبْغِضٌ قَالٍ: One who hates intensely, often implying exaggeration in hatred
key_terms.مُحِبٌّ غَالٍ: One who loves excessively, often implying exaggeration in love

ai.seo_question: What are the two types of people who will be ruined due to their attitude towards the Imams?
ai.summary: In this famous dictum from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) identifies two paths to spiritual ruin: the 'exaggerating lover' (al-muhibb al-ghali) who elevates him to divine status, and the 'exaggerating hater' (al-mubghid al-ghali) who rejects him entirely. This hadith serves as a foundational principle for Shia theology, warning against both the Ghulat (extremists) who deify the Imams and the Jahmiyyah or Khawarij who deny their authority, thereby establishing the ideal of moderate, balanced love (mawaddah) and respect.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 117. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
Two categories of persons will face ruin on account of me: he who loves me with exaggeration, and he who hates me intensely.
